notes: Lennox trade name for its economy line; parent Lennox. The page states Aire-Flo serial numbers follow Lennox serial number styles, but the month letter table is NOT imported from the repo Lennox file: the month chart on this page (Style-1_Airease-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png, 2015) is a different image file from the Lennox page's current chart (Lennox-Style-1-new.jpg, 2023), and month-letter mappings are known to differ between brands, so the image pass must read this page's own chart before any month ships. Style 1 therefore ships year-only. No other Aire-Flo style is documented on this page, so no further styles are claimed and no usesStylesOf is set.

styles.notes: Page positions 3-4 = year; 5th position = month letter (chart image only, held). Page example shown as 1606 B13871; identical example serial and chart image as the AirEase page Style 1.
